column1: # AEGIS handle-holder allowlist for AEGIS-GEN-001 / GEN-003 and the ETW OpenProcess rule (GEN-041).
# Columns (tab separated): image name | signer prefix | normalised path prefix
#   image name     exact file name, or * for any
#   signer prefix  Authenticode signer must start with this; * = any valid signer;
#                  - = unsigned accepted (name + path only, weaker: keep these rare)
# Script hosts and LOLBins (powershell, pwsh, wscript, cscript, mshta, rundll32, regsvr32,
# msbuild, InstallUtil, dotnet) can never be allowlisted: AEGIS-GEN-002 ignores this file.
# Keep entries keyed on signer + path, never name alone (roadmap A1).
# Windows components that hold handles to every process
# Roblox's own processes (the crash handler and launcher hold full handles to the client)
# Roblox bootstrappers. They launch the client, so they hold the CreateProcess handle.
# Bloxstrap and Fishstrap releases are not reliably code-signed, hence "-".
# Overlays and capture (roadmap A1 FP list). Verify the signer strings on a clean PC
